title: Canon Recovery Ledger Entry
description: One append-only line in docs/registries/canon-recovery-ledger.jsonl. Every field-level canon change has exactly one entry; without an entry no canon field changes.

id.description: Stable ledger entry id, e.g. R-<n> or <prototype>-<seq>.

field_path.description: JSON pointer into the prototype file, e.g. mechanisms[3].causal_chain.why_it_works or performance_data[7].verification_quote.

record_identity.description: The stable identity used to match (design §6.2).

key.description: Serialized key used at this identity level.

from_source_commit.description: Commit the evidence was drawn from.

local_file.description: Repo-relative path of the source PDF/visual_cache.

applied_commit.description: SHA of the canon commit that applied this entry.
